summary: RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K supplementing its joint proxy statement relating to its acquisition by The Real Brokerage Inc. through a newly formed holding company, Rome Wildlife, Inc. (to be renamed Real REMAX Group Inc.), which will trade as REAX on Nasdaq. The transaction, structured as an arrangement/merger, is expected to close in H2 2026, pending shareholder approvals at special meetings scheduled for August 14, 2026. The filing details the expected board of directors post-closing. No financial terms, premium, or advisor were stated. Watch for shareholder votes and regulatory conditions.
